Maxon Maxon Real Tube series browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Maxon ROD-881 Real Overdrive/Distortion Published on August 8, 2005 Maxon Real Tube series distortion overdrive pedal Information Maxon A tricked-out version of the ROD880, the ROD881 Real Overdrive/Distortion offers even more tone shaping control than its older cousin. Powered by a hand-selected 12AX7WXT preamp tube, the ROD881 takes all the great overdriven tube sounds of the ROD880 and turbo charges them by adding a switchable Distortion mode for searing, super-saturated guitar tones that rival the biggest of the big rigs in the amp world. In addition, the ROD881 features a Footswitchable Boost mode that effectively adds another channel to your amplifier. The ROD881's switchable Distortion mode adds a secondary, cascaded gain stage into the signal path for even more extreme tube punishment than the ROD880. In addition to simply adding more Gain, the selectable OD/Distortion modes greatly increase the versatility of the ROD881, allowing it to function in a variety of roles from semi-clean booster to ultra-high gain preamp. The ROD881's Footswitchable Boost function then allows the user to take full advantage of these sounds by creating an additional channel for quick changes between solos and rhythms. When combined with the various clean and drive settings on your amplifier, these two unique features create a multitude of easily accessible tone settings at the touch of your foot, effectively turning your amplifier into a two- or three-channel "uber" amp. The tones of the ROD881 can be fine tuned using via its large, easy-to adjust control panel. Gain and Master Volume provide complete and precise command of the ROD881's output level and amount of Drive. Bass, Treble, and Mid Boost controls with extended operation ranges offer a limitless array of tonal options, from the classic "808" tone to extremely beefy low end chunk. All of these sounds are then kept clean and noise-free via the rear mounted, switchable Noise Reduction circuitry with variable Threshold control and a 1:2 noise reduction ratio. Powered via a standard 9-volt DC adaptor that allows easy integration into your pedalboar

Maxon Maxon Re-Tube Real Tube series browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal events 2011 NAMM 2011 Maxon RTO700 Real Tube Overdrive Published on January 4, 2011 Maxon Re-Tube Real Tube series overdrive pedal NAMM 2011 Information Maxon Re-Tube Real Tube series A real-tube pedal for use with clean and semi-clean amps. The Maxon RTO700 Real Tube Overdrive Guitar Effects Pedal has no clipping diodes in the signal path - All distortion comes directly from the dual triode preamp tube and hi-gain amp circuit. This design makes the RTO the best tube overdrive pedal for use with clean and semi-clean amps to effectively add a 2nd or 3rd channel of pure tube tone to your rig. Every aspect of the RTO700 has been re-thought and redesigned to provide a lifetime of trouble-free performance. As soon as power is applied to the pedal, an In-Rush Current control begins heating the tube at a very low voltage (much like a tube amp standby switch) to dramatically extend tube life. When the pedal is engaged, a charge pump circuit bumps incoming voltage to feed the tube with 12.6 VDC. Unlike other tube overdrive pedals, the RTO700 places the tube AFTER the OD/Distortion circuits, making it the best tube overdrive pedal to recreate an authentic tube-amp tone. Gain and Master Controls allow the user to dial the amount of distortion and output level. The three Tone controls are completely independent with no frequency overlap, allowing for an unprecedented degree of tonal options. Everything is kept clean and tight via the variable VCA Noise Reduction circuit, which features an LED status indicator and On/Off switch. The RTO700's Front-Panel Controls are as follows - GAIN - Controls Gain level. MASTER - Controls output level allowing user to match effect and bypass levels . BASS - Controls low frequency range. MID - Controls middle frequency range. TREBLE - Controls high frequency range. NR - Controls amount of Noise Reduction when NR is switched on. NR On/Off - Turns Noise Reduction on/off. Like all Maxon products, the RTO700 features True Mechanical Bypass switching using a 3PDT switch. The RTO700 comes complete with the Maxon AC2009 9-Volt power supply, an auto sensing digital power supply that can be used anywhere in the world. Featur

sources.title: SM9pro+
sources.snippet: SM9pro+ - MAXON
sources.bodyExcerpt: SM9pro+ JAN : 4515615006409 UPC : 840433001560 SM9Pro+ was developed based on the distortion core of Maxon SM9 (Super Metal 9). Original SM9 was sold just after NWOBHM which created a big boom in the late 1970s. SM9Pro+ creates scooped heavy metal tones with high-level gain circuitry and cut midrange circuitry. Wide range of setting from NWOBHM to current heavy rock / loud rock using drop D tuning is available with simple four control knobs. Operating voltage (9V or 18V mode) is switchable via an internal slide switch accessible through the unit’s battery compartment. In new power-saving circuitry for SM9Pro+, DC to DC converter only operates at 18V mode. When 9V mode is selected, DC to DC converter does not operate, and SM9Pro+ operates with battery or AC adaptor directly. There is no power consumption for DC to DC converter, which makes battery life last longer. SM9Pro+ has increased dynamic headroom with internal operating voltage set at 18V. Stable high-quality sound is available as unintentionally-generated distortion is significantly reduced. TBS (True Bypass Switching) using 4PDT mechanical switch lets your instrument’s signal pass through a non-electronic bypass line when the effect is disengaged, feeding your amplifier with direct, unaltered signal from your instrument. No tone changes when the effect is engaged as signal does not pass through electronic switching circuitry. This TBS gains enormous popularity among artists. Easy-access, tool-free battery compartment. sources.title: Sentinel Metal Distortion / Ibanez® SM-9 Super Metal - Aion FX
sources.description: Based on the Ibanez® SM-9 Super Metal, one of the earliest distortion pedals designed specifically for metal tones.
sources.snippet: Sentinel Metal Distortion / Ibanez® SM-9 Super Metal - Aion FX
sources.bodyExcerpt: Sentinel Metal Distortion / Ibanez® SM-9 Super Metal - Aion FX --> Skip to content About Contact PCB white-labeling service Sign In / Register Menu Projects View All Projects Top Sellers Overdrive Distortion Modulation Delay Fuzz Boost Compression EQ Kits View All Kits Components Resources News More About Contact PCB white-labeling service Sign In / Register 0 items - $0.00 View Cart Checkout Search Sentinel Metal Distortion Based On Ibanez® SM-9 Super Metal Effect Type Metal Distortion Build Difficulty Advanced Project Summary One of the earliest distortion pedals designed specifically for metal tones, this effect features cascaded gain stages for a very amp-like topology. Printed Circuit Board What's included? PCB only. Build instructions and parts list can be viewed or downloaded from this page. In stock $ 16.00 In stock Sentinel quantity Add to cart Complete Kit Not yet available. Kits are developed based on interest, so if you’d like to see one for this project, let us know. Request Kit 54 people are interested. Project overview The Sentinel Metal Distortion is based on the Ibanez SM-9 Super Metal, a short-lived entry to the “9” series that was first released in 1983 and discontinued in 1984. The SM-9 is a very early example (perhaps the first) of a modern amp-like topology in a pedal: multi-stage clipping with tone-shaping before and after. Many solid-state preamps such as the Ampeg VH-140 and Diezel VH-4 employ similar concepts, as well as the Friedman Dirty Shirley and the lead channel of the BOSS® SD-2 Dual Overdrive . The Super Metal circuit was re-released three more times throughout the 1980s as the MS-10 Metal Charger, SM-L Super Metal, and SM-01 Super Metal, the latter of which was only in Japan under the Maxon brand name. All four of these are the same pedal internally. (The “reissue” Maxon SM-9 Pro+ from 2010 has not been traced, but just based on the exterior of the pedal, it’s clear it has some major differences and is not an exact clone.) The Sentinel is an exact clone of the SM-9, with two differences. First, the “Edge” control is normally a single knob that controls two gyrators at ~1.2kHz and ~2.3kHz. This is similar to the BOSS® HM-2, but unlike the HM-2 these two frequency bands don’t have much overlap—so we split them out into two knobs allowing both bands to be controlled independently. If they’re set in identical positions, it’ll be the same as the original SM-9, but this way you can fine-tune the high EQ a little more easily and get some expanded tones not found in the stock circuit. You can also lower the frequency of one of the bands if you want to experiment with creating a true midrange control (more information in the build document). The second difference is the addition of a charge pump for 18V operation. This increased voltage is switchable, so you can also run it at the stock 9V if you want, and even hard-wire it if you don’t care about the 18V option. Note: This project uses a type of capacitor that has been temporarily discontinued by WIMA. Please see our news article about the issue and the substitution spreadsheet for project-specific recommendations. We are stocking a limited supply in the mean time. The build document has not yet been updated to reflect this. Maxon Maxon 9 series browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by enclosure pedal events 2010 NAMM 2010 Maxon SM-9Pro+ Super Metal Published on January 6, 2010 Maxon 9 series distortion pedal NAMM 2010 Information Maxon USA Over the past 10 years Maxon effects have become a key ingredient in the guitar rigs of countless metal bands. Notable artists such as Killswitch Engage, Arch Enemy, As I Lay Dying, Dimmu Borgir, Shadow's Fall, and Behemoth have come to rely on Maxon effects to create their brutal guitar tones on stage and in the studio. The irony in this (pun intended) is that Maxon has never offered a pedal tailored to the needs of the metal guitarist - until now. Introducing the Maxon SM-9 Pro+ Super Metal - specifically designed to reproduce high-gain distortion tones with cut midrange, the SM-9 Pro+ can recreate anything from the classic crunch of the NWOBHM through to today's most extreme drop-tuned metal. Developing such a diverse circuit was no easy task, and the SM-9 was on the drawing board for years before Maxon deemed it worthy of release. Several unique "tricks" were incorporated to create a pedal that is as versatile as it is merciless. The SM-9 Pro+ features four controls: LEVEL - determines overall output level of pedal GAIN - Dual Pot configuration determines degree of Gain while also boosting midrange band up to 20 dB @ 1 kHz. EDGE - Controls hi-tone range (Hi-cut shelving filter continuously variable between 2-15 kHz). SCOOP - Controls the frequency range where the Midrange Cut occurs (mid-band Elimination filter continuously variable between 200 Hz and 2 kHz). By boosting and cutting specific frequency bands in relation to Gain, these four controls allow the user to sculpt brutal, chunky guitar tones that still retain note clarity and definition - a rarity among high-gain "metal" pedals. The SM-9 Pro+ also offers switchable 9- or 18-volt operation. In Classic 9-volt, the SM-9 runs at the incoming supply voltage, greatly extending battery life. When switched to Stabilized 18-volt setting, Maxon's proprietary DC-DC voltage doubler circuit increases the headroom, frequency range, and dynamic response of the SM-9 pedal. sources.snippet: SM9pro+ - MAXON
sources.bodyExcerpt: SM9pro+ JAN : 4515615006409 UPC : 840433001560 SM9Pro+ was developed based on the distortion core of Maxon SM9 (Super Metal 9). Original SM9 was sold just after NWOBHM which created a big boom in the late 1970s. SM9Pro+ creates scooped heavy metal tones with high-level gain circuitry and cut midrange circuitry. Wide range of setting from NWOBHM to current heavy rock / loud rock using drop D tuning is available with simple four control knobs. Operating voltage (9V or 18V mode) is switchable via an internal slide switch accessible through the unit’s battery compartment. In new power-saving circuitry for SM9Pro+, DC to DC converter only operates at 18V mode. When 9V mode is selected, DC to DC converter does not operate, and SM9Pro+ operates with battery or AC adaptor directly. There is no power consumption for DC to DC converter, which makes battery life last longer. SM9Pro+ has increased dynamic headroom with internal operating voltage set at 18V. Stable high-quality sound is available as unintentionally-generated distortion is significantly reduced. TBS (True Bypass Switching) using 4PDT mechanical switch lets your instrument’s signal pass through a non-electronic bypass line when the effect is disengaged, feeding your amplifier with direct, unaltered signal from your instrument. No tone changes when the effect is engaged as signal does not pass through electronic switching circuitry. This TBS gains enormous popularity among artists. Easy-access, tool-free battery compartment. This is because Maxon was always closely associated with Ibanez, and their effects pedals were mostly developed for Ibanez and sold under their name throughout the world. In the interim, word got out that the legendary Tubescreamer TS808 actually comes from Maxon, and in the course of the retro boom Maxon is now bringing almost all their old darlings back onto the market. Many might recall the SD9 Sonic Distortion; there was the pretty part (green mamba springs to mind), which was indeed with us in the 80s from Ibanez. And it sounds equally poisonous; in contrast to classic fuzz (as they were earlier called) pedals, the sound and dynamics are not messed up and the tone controller can also add some solid bass - that's some endless punch! The SD9 has a very particular distortion sound, which is typically loved or hated. However, in quieter settings more moderate crunch sounds are possible, which still manage to retain something of that wonderful scratchiness. sources.title: ST9pro+
sources.snippet: ST9pro+ - MAXON
sources.bodyExcerpt: ST9pro+ JAN : 4515615006416 UPC : 840433001577 ST9Pro+ was developed based on the legendary overdrive Maxon ST9, which was released in the 80s and still well-known even after it was discontinued. ST9 was reborn as ST9Pro+ with new circuitry. ST9Pro+ creates powerful, heavy, fat sound like a stack amp with midrange boost control. Wide range of setting, such as a booster, blues and hard rock, is available. With newly added selectable diode clip circuitry and low-end boost circuitry, more powerful distortion and low-end boost are available. Operating voltage (9V or 18V mode) is switchable via an internal slide switch accessible through the unit’s battery compartment. In new power-saving circuitry for ST9Pro+, DC to DC converter only operates at 18V mode. When 9V mode is selected, DC to DC converter does not operate, and ST9Pro+ operates with battery or AC adaptor directly. There is no power consumption for DC to DC converter, which makes battery life last longer. ST9Pro+ has increased dynamic headroom with internal operating voltage set at 18V. Stable high-quality sound is available as unintentionally-generated distortion is significantly reduced. TBS (True Bypass Switching) using 4PDT mechanical switch lets your instrument’s signal pass through a non-electronic bypass line when the effect is disengaged, feeding your amplifier with direct, unaltered signal from your instrument. No tone changes when the effect is engaged as signal does not pass through electronic switching circuitry. This TBS gains enormous popularity among artists. Easy-access, tool-free battery compartment. See other Maxon Distortion Overdrive Effects Pedals Product Description Versatile overdrive pedal provides full control over your sound. The TOD-9 True Tube Overdrive effects pedal takes Maxon’s classic OD-9 circuit and adds a tube gain stage at the front end to create an ultracompact, tube-driven tone machine. The Maxon OD-9 circuit has achieved a legendary status among tone connoisseurs as the ultimate tool for driving a tube amp. Yet sometimes you need that little "something extra," and the TOD-9 provides this missing ingredient in spades. The TOD-9 features a mil-spec 5703WB JAN Raytheon sub-miniature vacuum tube complete with its own separate Gain control (Tube knob). This tube stage is positioned at the front of the audio path, driving the OD-9 circuit. With the Tube knob at zero, the TOD-9 sounds exactly like an OD-9. Engage this control and experience the unmistakable magic of tube tone—a big, fat natural-sounding bottom end and the characteristic tube "sag" that makes lead lines sing. With the Drive knob down, the Tube knob will add warmth and dimension to your tone. With Drive knob up, you’ll get all this extra girth as well as increased saturation as the tube drives the clipping stage of the pedal. If big, warm tube tones are your bag, the TOD-9 offers them up in a familiar package that continues to withstand the tests of time. The TOD-9 provides all the classic tonality of the Maxon OD-9 with the ability to blend in tube-generated warmth and additional saturation. With the Crunch Plus we wanted to build the perfect combination of low gain overdrive and medium distortion in one pedal: something that has both sustain and squish while remaining Thick and organic. The Crunch Plus is the culmination of nearly a year of development What does it do? The Crunch Plus circuit starts with a low-gain overdriven preamp section that leads into our take on asymmetric distortion resulting in a fat driven sound with a unique edge. Controls Gain: This controls the amount of gain driving the pedal's hard clipping. Minimum setting is similar to the Crunch Transparent Overdrive on 3/4 gain with a an added edge. The Crunch Plus pedal never loses that edge, it builds on it as you bring up the gain. Tone: A mid-range control that works very much like the tone control on most guitars. Vol: This adjusts the amplified and clipped signal after it leaves the tone filter. LED Brightness (unmarked trimpot on side of pedal unmarked): As someone who plays daytime outdoor shows, I wanted a super bright LED; however, this made it horrible to use in any other situation. So, I added a trimpot to that allows you to vary the LED Brightness from dark stage to bright sun. Please make the adjustment gently using a jeweler’s screwdriver. Features Touch-sensitive crunch, clarity, and sustain without muddy tovertones or buzzy top end” –Vintage Guitar Magazine, Sept, 2021 Anthony Della Croce from The Headpins adds the following: LED Brightness ADJUSTMENT....no worries, this is not a DIMMER and will not interfere with your tone. What an awesome addition especially for us old guys on sunny day stages! SIMPLICITY...dial your tone in without endless tweaking “VERY QUIET...low noise compared to my other pedals DYNAMIC with picking style and volume knob changes. SECRET INGREDIENTS...yup, some secret HIGHER QUALITY components that make this pedal sing!!! How to With the Gain at approximately 1/3 or below the overdrive stage is engaged but only part of the distortion, resulting in an overdrive sound with a bit of an edge. As you bring the gain up beyond the 1/3-ish area, the distortion circuit starts to bloom. The tone control is a variable low pass filter, as you turn the pot counter clockwise you lower the corner frequency, attenuating the highs frequencies. For guitar, start with the control up approximately 2/3 and adjust to taste. For bass, start with the pot at noon and adjust to taste. The Double Crunch puts a complete Original Crunch and a complete Extra Crunch in one box—two independent circuits sharing only the power supply. sources.bodyExcerpt: Octave Fuzz with Stank | Rectified Octave-Up Fuzz | McGregor Pedals Free Shipping Available Canada Wide!!! Log in or Create account Cart 0 Free Shipping Available Canada Wide!!! Menu Cart 0 Fuzz Pedals Crunch Overdrive Products Video Demos Press Our Story Special Orders Contact Log in Create account Fuzz Pedals Crunch Overdrive Products Video Demos Press Our Story Special Orders Contact Home › Octave Fuzz with Stank McGregor Pedals Octave Fuzz with Stank Regular price $185.00 USD Sale price Unit price / per Shipping calculated at checkout. Default Title - $185.00 USD Quantity Add to Cart Classic rectified octave-up fuzz with a Stank control that overloads the octaving circuit for positively filthy tones—not a polite octave doubler. Blend wet and dry, dial from shimmering octave fuzz to full stank. Hand-soldered in British Columbia for guitar and bass. ▶ Watch video demos Why fuzz players choose the Octave Fuzz with Stank Rectified octave-up voice — full-wave rectification doubles frequency for a fuzzy octave-up character; complex guitar and bass signals get wild in the best way Stank control — overload the octaving section on purpose for distortion blended with octave fuzz—a tone discovered during development, not an afterthought Blend — parallel mix from mostly dry (never fully dry) to fully wet Guitar and bass — responds to pickup output, playing dynamics, and signal complexity Hand-soldered in BC — true bypass, top-mounted jacks, LED brightness trim for outdoor stages Player-tested — Michael Schau demo below; same player community as the Crunch and Classic Fuzz lines How Stank works — the circuit The core circuit takes a relatively pure tone and doubles the frequency by inverting the positive portion of the wave—full-wave rectification. That yields a fuzzy octave-up sound. With the rich harmonic content of a guitar or bass, the result is aggressive, animated, and unpredictable in a musical way. During development we found that pushing too much signal through the octaving section didn’t just break up—it became positively “Stanky” (as one player put it). That happy accident became the Stank knob: think of it as distortion mixed with the octave-up fuzz, not a generic gain control. Quick voicing tip: With Stank up and Blend around 10 o’clock, it behaves like a distortion with octave overtones—useful for rhythm and chord work without full wet fuzz. Michael Schau demo Michael Schau taking the Octave Fuzz with Stank for a spin: ▶ All McGregor Pedals demos → Controls Vol — Output level. Turning up Stank can boost volume; adjust Vol as needed Stank — Overloads the octaving circuit—distortion blended with octave-up fuzz Blend — Wet/dry mix. Full left is mostly dry (it never fully dries up); full right is completely wet LED brightness — Side trim pot (jeweler’s screwdriver): dark stage to bright sun How to use it Starting point: Blend around noon, Stank low, set Vol to match your bypass level Octave fuzz: Bring Blend toward fully wet; add Stank to taste for filth vs. clarity Distortion + octave overtones: Stank up, Blend around 10 o’clock—rhythm-friendly voicing Bass: Works well on bass; complex low-end content drives the rectifier hard—start with lower Stank and adjust Blend Before Crunch: Stacks well with transparent overdrive after fuzz for cranked-amp textures at manageable volume Specifications Type: Rectified octave-up fuzz with overload Stank control (guitar bass) Controls: Vol, Stank, Blend + LED brightness trim Bypass: True bypass Power: 9 V DC, center-negative 2.1 × 5.5 mm (Boss-style). sources.description: Not a vintage fuzz clone—a fuzz → distortion → overdrive cascade. Attack morphs from OD to full stack. Vintage Guitar reviewed. Hand-soldered in BC. Hear the demos.

sources.bodyExcerpt: The Cozmic Fuzzball | Fuzz → Distortion → OD | McGregor Pedals Free Shipping Available Canada Wide!!! Log in or Create account Cart 0 Free Shipping Available Canada Wide!!! Menu Cart 0 Fuzz Pedals Crunch Overdrive Products Video Demos Press Our Story Special Orders Contact Log in Create account Fuzz Pedals Crunch Overdrive Products Video Demos Press Our Story Special Orders Contact Home › The Cozmic Fuzzball McGregor Pedals The Cozmic Fuzzball Regular price $185.00 USD Sale price Unit price / per Shipping calculated at checkout. Default Title - $185.00 USD Quantity Add to Cart Not a vintage fuzz clone. The Cozmic Fuzzball runs fuzz → distortion → overdrive in series—a hybrid you morph with one knob. Attack at minimum is overdrive only; turn up Attack to layer distortion in front, then fuzz in front of that. Hand-soldered in British Columbia for guitar and bass. ▶ Watch video demos | Read the Vintage Guitar review → | Press release Why players choose the Cozmic Fuzzball Original circuit — not another Fuzz Face spin; designed to inspire new tones, not replicate old ones One knob, three textures — Attack blends overdrive, distortion, and fuzz in a single cascade Touch-sensitive — responds to picking dynamics, volume knob, and pickup output Tracks fast passages — sustains and follows scalar lines without turning to mud Quiet for a fuzz — low noise with clean power; high-impedance input (doesn’t have to be first in chain) Hand-soldered in BC — true bypass, top-mounted jacks, LED brightness trim How Attack works — signal flow The Cozmic Fuzzball is three stages in series: fuzz → distortion → overdrive . Attack at minimum: Overdrive only—the back of the chain Attack up: Distortion is layered in front of the overdrive Attack further up: Fuzz is layered in front of the distortion (and overdrive) Pickup output and your guitar’s volume pot strongly affect how much fuzz comes in—hot humbuckers push into fuzz sooner; roll back for cleaner textures. Bass players: start with Attack near minimum and go from there. As reviewed in Vintage Guitar “Sweet Gnarly” — McGregor Cozmic Fuzzball , Vintage Guitar “Straddles overdrive, distortion, and fuzz textures but never appropriates one over the other… tracks well for fast scalar passages, and is great for players hip to picking dynamics.” “Gnarly tones with musical sheen… adjusting Tone and Attack together showcases the pedal’s response with squish and a lot of sustain.” “It’s a hybrid with plenty of character, perfect for players looking to craft their own voice .” “The Cozmic Fuzzball doesn’t do metal, can’t nail Hendrix fuzz tones, and won’t take you to SRV land. What it does is something unique.” — honest expectations for pros comparing it to genre benchmarks. Video demos ▶ All McGregor Pedals demos → Controls Attack — Strength of signal into the fuzz transistor; more Attack = more fuzz and sustain. Low settings = distortion/overdrive; pinned = fuzz-land Tone — Variable high-pass filter; left = more bottom end (bass-friendly), right = guitar and bass Vol — Output after the tone filter LED brightness — Side trim pot (jeweler’s screwdriver): dark stage to bright sun How to use it Guitar starting point: Attack ~1/3 or below = mostly distortion/overdrive; bring up Attack to layer fuzz in Tone: Clockwise raises the corner frequency and rolls off lows—start around 10 o’clock on guitar and adjust. Bass : Start with Tone fully left; bring up to taste Before Crunch: Stacks well with transparent overdrive after fuzz for stacked amp-like textures Specifications Type: Hybrid fuzz / distortion / overdrive cascade (guitar bass) Signal path: Fuzz → distortion → overdrive (Attack blends layers) Controls: Attack, Tone, Vol + LED brightness trim Input: High impedance—doesn’t have to be first in chain Bypass: True bypass Power: 9 V DC, center-negative 2.1 × 5.5 mm (Boss-style). 12–18 mA depending on LED setting Layout: Top-mounted jacks and power Built: Hand-soldered in British Columbia, Canada Battery: No

It follows on the heels of the McGregor's previous pedals, the Crunch Transparent Overdrive, a single-channel, low-gain overdrive pedal for guitar and bass, released in December 2019 and the Crunch Plus Overdrive, a medium-gain version for guitar and bass released in December 2020. - News from McGregor Pedals Inc., issued by Send2Press Newswire

It follows on the heels of the McGregor’s previous pedals, the Crunch Transparent Overdrive , a single-channel, low-gain overdrive pedal for guitar and bass, released in December 2019 and the Crunch Plus Overdrive , a medium-gain version for guitar and bass released in December 2020. Designed and built by Garth Heslop, the brand new Cozmic Fuzzball pedal is built on the same foundation as the previous two pedals, though you would never know it. Heslop takes it to the next level by stacking hard clipping with soft clipping and adding an overdriven transistor for that sweet fuzz tone. Beginning with the attack control on minimum the Cozmic Fuzzball delivers distortion with a bright creamy edge. “As you bring up the attack the distortion gets heavier; by noon on the attack, you have already started to hear fuzz layered in. Both the fuzz and the sustain grow from there. The Cozmic Fuzzball was designed for both guitar and bass,” Heslop says. See the Cozmic Fuzzball demo video here: https://youtu.be/yPtQpVnYh1s See all three McGregor Pedals here: https://youtu.be/tdcZqE39DXo The Cozmic Fuzzball has a straightforward control set: Attack: This controls strength of the signal hitting the fuzz transistor; more attack = more fuzz and sustain. At the lower end with low output pickups the effect is mild distortion/overdrive. As you bring up the attack the distortion gets stronger. Soon you will hear fuzz starting to layer in. Pin the Attack and you are in fuzz-land. The output of your pickups will have a significant effect on how much fuzz is generated (as will your guitar’s volume pot) Tone: this is a variable high pass filter; the left side of the range is more for bass guitar, the right for both bass and guitar. Vol: This attenuates the amplified and clipped signal after it leaves the tone filter. LED Brightness (Unmarked Trimpot on the side): Please make the adjustment gently using a jeweler’s screwdriver. Key Cozmic Fuzzball features: Hand soldered in Vancouver, Canada High grade components picked for their superior sound and response True bypass with soft-click switch Standard 9-volt DC center-negative power operation (no battery compartment) Top-mounted audio jacks and power input to help with packed pedal boards The Cozmic Fuzzball is currently priced at USD $210 and can be purchased directly from the McGregor Pedals online store via https://www.mcgregorpedals.com/ . sources.bodyExcerpt: McGregor Pedals Cozmic Fuzzball: A Deep Technical and Musical Analysis of a Boutique Fuzz Reimagined | GearStrings GEARSTRINGS Home Blog Categories Authors About Home / Blog / practice tips practice tips McGregor Pedals Cozmic Fuzzball: A Deep Technical and Musical Analysis of a Boutique Fuzz Reimagined By Nina Harper July 15, 2026 What Is the Cozmic Fuzzball? More Than Just Another Fuzz The McGregor Pedals Cozmic Fuzzball is a hand-built, analog fuzz pedal designed and manufactured in Portland, Oregon, by luthier and circuit designer Ben McGregor. Introduced in late 2021, it departs from conventional fuzz topology by integrating three discrete gain stages, a dual-path clipping architecture, and a fully voltage-controlled bias system — all housed in a compact 4.5" × 2.75" × 1.75" aluminum enclosure weighing 385 grams. Unlike vintage-inspired clones or simplified op-amp fuzzes, the Cozmic Fuzzball leverages discrete NPN transistors (2N5088 and BC549C) for primary amplification and employs a hybrid clipping approach using both silicon (1N4148) and germanium (OA90) diodes, switchable via a front-panel toggle. Its design targets dynamic responsiveness, harmonic complexity, and studio-grade noise floor performance — measured at ≤2.1 µV RMS (A-weighted) with 9V DC power. This article examines how its engineering choices translate to musical utility across genres, supported by technical measurements, player feedback from verified users, and comparative analysis against benchmarks like the Electro-Harmonix Big Muff Pi (v1974), Dunlop Fuzz Face (Dallas-Arizona), and EarthQuaker Devices Hoof. Circuit Architecture: Three Stages, Two Clipping Paths, One Bias Engine The Cozmic Fuzzball’s signal path begins with a JFET-input buffer (Toshiba 2SK369) that preserves high-impedance pickup integrity and minimizes loading — critical for preserving top-end clarity when cascading with other pedals. This feeds into Stage 1: a common-emitter amplifier built around a 2N5088 transistor biased at 1.82 mA collector current (measured at 25°C ambient). Stage 2 uses a BC549C configured as a shunt-fed amplifier with emitter degeneration, delivering 14.3 dB voltage gain and introducing subtle even-order harmonics. Stage 3 is the core saturation stage: another 2N5088 operating at 2.15 mA, followed by the dual-clipping network. Unlike traditional fuzzes where clipping occurs passively after gain, the Cozmic Fuzzball places clipping *within* the feedback loop of Stage 3’s emitter follower — enabling precise harmonic sculpting without collapsing headroom. Clipping Switch: Silicon vs. Germanium — Not Just Tone, But Transient Response The silicon/germanium toggle isn’t merely an EQ shift — it alters clipping threshold, recovery time, and harmonic decay profile. With silicon diodes (1N4148), the onset is sharper (rise time Bias Control: Voltage-Regulated Precision, Not Potentiometer Drift Most vintage-style fuzzes rely on manual bias pots susceptible to thermal drift and mechanical wear. The Cozmic Fuzzball replaces this with a temperature-compensated voltage reference IC (TL431AC) feeding a low-noise op-amp (OPA2134) that drives a MOSFET-based current sink. This system maintains collector current within ±2.3% across 0–40°C ambient — verified via thermal chamber testing per IEC 60068-2-14. As a result, the Bias knob delivers repeatable, non-logarithmic sweep: turning from 0 to 100% increases Stage 3’s quiescent current linearly from 1.2 mA to 2.8 mA. This directly modulates compression ratio and harmonic density without altering frequency response — unlike conventional fuzz volume/gain controls. In practice, bias settings below 30% yield clean boost with mild edge; 45–75% unlocks classic fuzz sustain with vocal-like midrange bloom; above 85%, the pedal enters gated, synth-like oscillation territory — controllable via pick attack and guitar volume taper. sources.bodyExcerpt: Menatone - Blue collar (version 3 / '04) Skip to main content Bernard d'Uur's little lab; the docter is in! Search Search This Blog Menatone - Blue collar (version 3 / '04) on September 09, 2025 Get link Facebook X Pinterest Email Other Apps I got this 2004 Menatone The Blue Collar in for some repairs. The unit sounds off with a slight misbiased sound that doesn't respond to any controls. Menatone started in 1996 with building pedals. Their first pedal was the Red Snapper (check my post on thus pedal here ); later the Blue Collar Overdrive followed. This pedal added some more gain to the equation and gave players sounds where the Red Snapper stopped. The Blue Collar was produced in approximate four versions. T his TGP post sums up the differences between the models from the outside.The pedal was produced in the famous PTP style print but also in PCB versions. Nowadays you can order a PTP version again from Menatone. The circuit The Blue Collar is housed in a beautiful blue box with four knobs and a single footswitch. In- and Outputs are located on the sides and on the top the DC jack is located. As this unit is an overdrive pedal, it has controls for the amount of overdrive ('Gain'), the EQ of the overdrive tone ('Tone' and 'Pres') and the volume of the overdrive ('Vol'). The footswitch turns the pedal on and off. It can be run on a 9V DC adapter but also on a battery. When opened up you can view the inside of this pedal that is a pure art-form; the pedal is made on perfboard but made with eyelets as can be found in vintage and boutique amplifiers. On these eyelets the pedal is built with through hole components and jumpers on the underside of the pedal. With long wires the potmeters are attached to the circuit board. A schematic floats around on the internet and can be found on this post on DIYstompboxes . For ease I'll add it to this blog but I don't know the original tracer or owner of the schematic (and can't give him credits on his work). If you know who made this please contact me and I'll add that to the schematic / text. As this schematic does not match the components you can find on the circuit board of this version of the pedal I traced the pedal: As you can spot there are a couple of differences when compared with the above named schematic. What is most prominent is the choice of opamp, the quite large input resistor, the orientation of the clipping diodes and the FET booster on the output. The circuit mimics that of a Tubescreamer with some components value change, the loss of the input buffer (and switching part) and the addition of the 'Pres' knob that alters the frequency response of the opamp but also alters the gain response of the opamp. The addition of the FET booster on the end of the pedal feels weird: why was it added? The original circuit should already have enough volume. Or where they looking for some other colouration by adding this FET? I asked the people at Menatone for this: some one was definitaly messing around with that one. the diode correction you did is the right way. early Blue Collars were quiet without the extra fet stage. the extra stage was added in the early to mid 2000s with the introduction of the original fish factory pedal. the blue collars since around 2004 or 5 have had the extra fet stage The fix The pedal sounded a but misbiased, mostly in the lower notes. When a chord was played it wasn't as apparent and with low gain settings the effect was quite little. As you can see in the schematic the orientation of the diodes is off. Instead of clipping different parts of the waveform only one part works and the other part of the waveform isn't clipped in the same matter. This resulted in the misbiased sounds the owner was hearing. So was this a choice made by Menatone or did someone just did a bad job soldering and overlooked this error? We will never know! Launched in late 1996, the Blue Collar was designed specifically for single coil players, delivering a rich, fat sound while maintaining string definition and clarity, along with enough gain for notes to truly shine. This Mojo version incorporates the same premium components used in high-end amplifiers and includes all top-mounted jacks with 9-18 volt compatibility. Launched in late 1996, the Blue Collar was designed specifically for single coil players, delivering a rich, fat sound while maintaining string definition and clarity, along with enough gain for notes to truly shine. This Mojo version incorporates the same premium components used in high-end amplifiers and includes all top-mounted jacks with 9-18 volt compatibility. sources.description: Menatone メナトーン Blue Collar Mojo PTP オーバードライブ ギターエフェクター・Red Snapperのゲインとコンプレッションを高めたサウンド・クリーントーンからフルゲインまで広いゲインレンジ・ポイントtoポイント、最高級コンポーネントを採用Blue Collarオーバードライブは、Menaoneにとって2番目に完成したペダルデザインです。Red Snapperにより高いゲインとコンプレッションを求めるリクエストから1997年に開発されたのがBlue Collarでした。Blue Collar Mojo PTPは、最高級のハンドメイドペダルを作り続けてきたMenatoneによるMojoバージョンです。Mojoバージョンは、ハイエンドアンプに使用されているものと同様のプレミアムコンポーネントを採用し、9〜18V駆動に対応させました。過去最高のBlue Collarです。特にシングルコイルとの相性がよく、ミッドレンジが太いトーンを生み出します。1台でクリーントーンから倍音とサステインが豊かで美しくなめらかなフルゲインまで、広いゲインレンジをカバーします。スム

Blue Collar The Blue Collar overdrive is the second pedal design from Menatone. It debuted in 1997 at a request for a Red Snapper with more gain and compression. The Blue Collar produces a fat, midrangey tone that loves single coils. The gain ranges from just above clean to a beautiful, full, smooth grind with great harmonics and sustain. About • Collections • Blog • Compare • Privacy Policy • Terms of Service • Submit a pedal • © 2026 PedalFilter Clear Compare ( 0 ) Back Home Menatone Blue Collar PTP Back to results Menatone Blue Collar PTP Overdrive Fat, midrange-forward overdrive built for single-coils, from clean edge to smooth grind. The Blue Collar is Menatone's other long-running overdrive, dating to around 1997, voiced fatter and more midrange-forward than the transparent Red Snapper and especially suited to single-coil guitars that need more body. Its gain runs from just above clean up to a full, smooth grind with strong harmonics and long sustain, staying smooth rather than fizzy at the top of its range. This PTP version is point-to-point wired in a compact enclosure with top-mounted jacks. Hand-built to order in the USA, it works as a standalone drive or stacked with the Red Snapper. This mini version is the exact same as the original with the same parts and circuit Full sized through hole parts are used throughout, no surface mount in here. The Hindenburg mini will be sold direct from Menatone only, which accounts for the amazing price. Just like every other Menatone pedal, each one is made by hand, one at a time in the USA Dimensions are 1.5" x 3.66" Power supply must be used, no battery for the mini. Top Boost in a Can Wreck'T Fish Factory MenaWatt PiG The Dirty Blonde MINI Red Snapper Mini Red Snapper 4 knob Mini Blue Collar Mini JAC Compressor Mini Thundering Revival Mini The Law Mini Hindenburg Mini Mail Bomb Mini Pleasure Trem Mini Ms. Foxy Brown Mini PIPES IN STOCK CONTACT POLICIES DEALERS More Use tab to navigate through the menu items. THE LAW BENDER $259 Add to Cart DEMOS Coming soon... The Law Bender Deluxe is the next evolution of the Menatone Law fuzz. Based on the same circuit but with the added 'PORK' control for more gain. The PORK control turns the first gain stage from a unity gain buffer, to a 12db exrtra boost stage similar to a MKii fuzz. The Law Bender goes from light overdrive to full blown nastiness. The new Deluxe version now has both silicone and germanium tranistors switchable in both stages. The Silicon has more gain on tap and a tigher response, while the Germanium has more midrange and an organic vibe with a bit less gain. Both provide a hugely dynamic experience with clarity and nuance not found in any other fuzz pedals. 1/2 Watt Carbon resistors and rolled poly caps are used throughout. Based on the same circuit but with the added ‘PORK’ control for more gain. The PORK control turns the first gain stage from a unity gain buffer, to a 12db exrtra boost stage similar to a MKii fuzz. The Law Bender goes from light overdrive to full blown nastiness. Now available in either the normal Silicon transitors or hand picked NOS Germanium trannies. The Silicon has more gain on tap and a tigher response, while the Germanium has more midrange and an organic vibe with a bit less gain. Both provide a hugely dynamic experience with clarity and nuance not found in any other fuzz pedals. 1/2 Watt Carbon resistors and rolled poly caps are used throughout. The PORK control turns the first gain stage from a unity gain buffer, to a 12db exrtra boost stage similar to a MKii fuzz. Menatone The Law Fuzz (and Brian Mena Hand Carved Pipe!) MenaWatt v.III $219 Add to Cart The MenaWatt is based on the other, other British amps from the 60's and 70's. It is brash and articulate with plenty of meat in the middle and a tight bass. The internally jumpered inputs allow individual tailoring of the 'normal' and 'brilliant' channels just like a jumpered amp. The MenaWatt gain goes from clean to full vintage crunch but also has a trim pot inside for even more gain if needed. Now with Power Gain and Presence controls, and top mounted jacks. Now you can have your "meat" and the 'pudding' too. sources.bodyExcerpt: MenaWatt by Menatone | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Menatone MenaWatt LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS OVERDRIVE BOOSTER EQUALIZER Description The MenaWatt is based on the other, other British amps from the 60's and 70's. It is brash and articulate with plenty of meat in the middle and a tight bass. The internally jumpered inputs allow individual tailoring of the 'normal' and 'brilliant' channels just like a jumpered amp. The MenaWatt gain goes from clean to full vintage crunch but also has a trim pot inside for even more gain if needed. Now with two treble cut switches inside to further match to your amp. This new v.III adds the power gain to the outside for fuller control. Now you can have your "meat" and the 'pudding' too. with his superb MenaWatt compact edition Preamp Pedal Oct 30, 2024 08:00 by Stefan Karlsson Boost Boost and Overdrive Distortion Drive Menatone Overdrive + - Full Article Read Summary Key Points Hiwatt DR103 Custom 100, associated with Dave Reeves (1966–1981), was a loud, high-headroom British amplifier noted for build quality and used by Pete Townshend, John Entwistle, David Gilmour, The Edge, Eddie Vedder, Robert Fripp, Ronnie Wood, Kevin Shield, Neal Schon, J Mascis and Tommy Bolin. Brian Mena’s MenaWatt V3 compact Preamp Pedal blends Brilliant and Normal gains, with Volume, Bass, Mid, Treb, Power Gain and an internal Amp Match Trimmer. The article lists it at $209 from the Menatone Webstore, made mostly to order, and notes limited demos. The MenaWatt and Wreck’T recreate their source amps’ flavours and dynamics. There was a time when Hiwatt stood shoulder-to-shoulder with Marshall and Vox at the top of the British Amplifier hierarchy. In fact during the Dave Reeves Era (1966-1981) Hiwatt was considered the superior amp brand of the day - with significantly better build quality than all the rest. This had much to do with Dave’s dual apprenticeships at Marconi and Mullard - where he was imbued with MilSpec production values - such that those devices could be more easily and expediently maintained. MilSpec precision was most apparent in the neatness of the wiring - where Dave’s builds were head and shoulders above anything else made around the same time. The DR103 was sometimes associated with the Marshall Super Lead Plexi, but it’s an entirely different circuit - which delivers a lot more headroom on cleans, and more flavour / vibrancy when overdriven and distorted. Some mentioned that a Marshall could sound positively anaemic when driven next to a Hiwatt DR103 Custom 100 in full flow. For a long time the DR103 was known for being the preeminent gigging amp of its time - as it was consistently louder than pretty much everything else available - and as a result you had a broad collection of artists who used the amp in a variety of ways. Notably this was the original Who amp - as favoured by Pete Townshend and John Entwistle. While it’s probably best known for being David Gilmour’s favourite amp across his extensive career - where he loves it for that super massive clean headroom that helps make his lead lines soar so well. NONE MORE BLACK Top of Page None More Black Deluxe The None More Black is an ultra high gain distortion that takes concepts from all of my favorite amps from the 80s to the present. No clipping diodes and no op amps, this purely discrete circuit oozes an organic character that eludes other pedals in the field. Its unique eq controls allow for a very wide range of tones from ultra scooped to modern midrange punch. The gain control goes from vintage 800 style to all out mayhem. Scroll down for more info. Build time is usually 4-6 weeks or so $259 Add to Cart DEMOS All demos played poorly by Menatone unless otherwise noted. Amp is a princeton style 5w running into a Ox Amp Top Box. Amp settings are very clean to not hide the sound of the pedal. bridge PAF 4x12 V30

Top Boost in a Can Wreck'T Fish Factory MenaWatt PiG The Dirty Blonde MINI Red Snapper Mini Red Snapper 4 knob Mini Blue Collar Mini JAC Compressor Mini Thundering Revival Mini The Law Mini Hindenburg Mini Mail Bomb Mini Pleasure Trem Mini Ms. Foxy Brown Mini PIPES IN STOCK CONTACT POLICIES DEALERS More Use tab to navigate through the menu items. The PiG A man from Australia contacted me one morning about 3am. As usual I was up and he proceeded to ask me if I knew about the British "Pig" amp that Ronno played in his Glam Rock phase. After a long discussion the Menatone Custom Shop PiG was born. Based on an incredibly rare, high power British amp, the PiG is simply oozing with fat, ripping rock, and grissly, thick, bluesy goodness. This new 2025 PiG takes the internal switches for presence boost and cut and puts them on a toggle switch on top. Also all top mounted jacks now. ​ ​ Build time is approx. 4-6 weeks 219 Add to Cart DEMO for some reason youtube videos are not working on the site... i am trying to figure it out. In the mean time you can search youtube for the Menatone demos. The PiG is an overdrive and distortion voiced after a rare British 'Pig' amplifier used in glam rock, aimed at fat, ripping rock tones and thick, gristly blues grind. A presence boost-and-cut toggle, top-mounted on the current version, shifts the top-end response to match different amps and rooms. Rather than a transparent overdrive it's a colored, amp-style drive with its own strong midrange voice, built for classic and hard rock rhythm and lead work. It's hand-built to order in the USA, point-to-point wired. Red Snapper 4kb PTP $229 Add to Cart The Red Snapper is the pedal that started it all for Menatone. It debuted in 1996 in its original 3 knob form made point to point, one at a time and is still made the same way 30 years later. The concept was simple, make the most transparent touch sensitive overdrive that could possibly be made, and three decades later it still holds up. The four knob version adds the hi cut control that is designed in such a way that it is completely out of the circuit when turned all the way down, but adds a level of tonal versatility that the three knob original cannot match. この記事では、確認できる一次情報とアーカイブ情報をもとに、MENATONEの歪み系をできるだけ体系的に整理します。 MENATONEとは何者か MENATONEは公式サイトで**“Effects Since 1996”**を掲げるハンドメイド・アナログ系ブランドです。現行公式サイトでは、PTP/Deluxe、Standard、Miniというカテゴリで多数の歪み系が並び、LEP Internationalの取扱ページでは27製品、Effects Databaseでは36製品が確認できます。つまり、ブランドの輪郭は公式で追えても、歴代の全体像はアーカイブと流通情報を重ねないと見えてきません。この記事ではその前提に立って、 歪み系＝オーバードライブ、ディストーション、アンプライクなドライブ、ファズ に絞って整理します。 もうひとつ大事なのは、MENATONEの“アンプ系”ペダルは、代理店の解説でも アンプそのものに完全変換するモデラーというより、元のアンプを活かしたままフレーバーを加える歪み として説明されていることです。これはShut Up Drive Miniの説明や、LEPのnote記事でも一貫していて、MENATONEを理解するキーワードは「再現」よりも「香りの抽出」に近いと考えるとわかりやすいです。だからこそ、同じMarshall系やVox系でも、他社の“○○そのもの”を強く名乗るペダルとは手触りが少し違います。 小要約 MENATONEは、 透明系ODの始祖クラス でもあり、 アンプの個性を“歪みペダルとして料理する”ブランド でもあります。 ここを押さえると、後の歴代モデルがつながって見えてきます。 まず全体像｜MENATONE歪み系の系譜 細かい発売順を厳密な年表で並べる前に、系統で見ると理解が一気に楽になります。大まかには、 Red Snapper系のオープンな低〜中ゲインOD群 、 Blue Collar系の太く歌うOD群 、 Marshall/Vox/Hiwatt/TrainwreckなどBritishアンプ派生群 、 DumbleやBlonde/Brownface、Supro系のAmerican/ブティック群 、そして ハイゲイン／ファズ群 に分けられます。公式・代理店・FXDBの説明を突き合わせると、MENATONEは単にモデル数が多いのではなく、歪みの設計思想ごとに枝分かれしてきたブランドだとわかります。 特に重要なのは、 Red Snapper→Blue Collar→Fish Factory という“基礎ODライン”、 Workingman’s Blue→King of the Britains→The King→Shut Up Drive/Thundering Revival/Redneck vs. Sputnik/None More Black というBritish拡張ライン、 Top Boost in a Can / MenaWatt / PiG / Kar Krash / Wreck’t という“英アンプ個性派ライン”、そして Howie / Dumbstruck / Dirty Blonde / Dirty B / Hindenburg / Ms.Foxy Brown というAmerican〜ブティック路線です。これを頭に入れておくと、歴代モデルを単発で覚える必要がなくなります。 原点の2台｜Red SnapperとBlue Collar Red Snapper｜MENATONEの始まり Red Snapperは、MENATONEにとって最重要モデルです。公式のMojo PTPページとLEPの解説では、もともと1996年に“Red”として始まり、1998年のNAMMで“Red Snapper”として広くデビューしたと説明されています。FXDBでも、3ノブ版から4ノブ版、各種レイアウト違いまで多くの写真が残っており、歴代歪み系の“起点”と見てまず間違いありません。 音のキャラクターは、公式・FXDBの両方が オープンで、コンプレッションが少なく、透明感のあるオーバードライブ として説明しています。2005年のFXDB説明では“transparent overdrive”、2009年の説明では“very open and uncompressed overdrive”とされ、Biteでピックアタック帯を押し出し、後段のHi Cutで高域を整える思想が読み取れます。つまりRed Snapperは、単なる“薄いOD”ではなく、 弾き手のピッキングとアンプの個性を殺さずに歪みを足す ためのペダルです。 世代差で大きいのは、 3ノブ版と4ノブ版 です。4ノブ版ではHi Cutが追加され、Biteで押し出した高域をあとから整えられるようになりました。しかも現行LEPページは、3ノブ版の冒頭スペック欄では「Vol / Gain / Cut」と書きつつ、本文では「Bite」の説明をしており、資料上に表記の食い違いがあります。中古で仕様確認をするときは、 商品名だけでなく実機写真のノブ名を必ず見る のが安全です。 現行派生としては、Red Snapper Mojo PTP、Red Snapper 4 Knob PTP、Red Snapper Mini、Red Snapper 4 Knob Miniが確認できます。Mini版も公式では「元回路と同じ」「フルサイズのスルーホール部品使用」と説明されており、単なる廉価縮小版というより、 省スペース化した本流 として扱うのが自然です。MENATONEを初めて買う人が“ブランドらしさ”を最短で知るなら、今もRed Snapper系は最有力候補です。 Blue Collar｜Red Snapperの“もっと太く、もっと歌う”側 Blue Collarは、公式説明では MENATONEの2番目のペダル設計 です。発売時期は公式内でも少し揺れがあり、Blue Collar PTP/miniでは1997年デビュー、Mojo版ではlate 1996とされていますが、少なくとも ブランド最初期の相棒 であることは確かです。Red Snapperに対して「もっとゲインとコンプレッションを」という要望から生まれた、という説明も一貫しています。 Blue Collarの要点は、 太いミッド、なめらかなコンプレッション、シングルコイルとの相性 です。公式は“fat, midrangey tone that loves single coils”、FXDBは“compressed, mid hump, singing bluesy overdrive”と書いており、Red Snapperの開放感に対して、Blue Collarはより“歌う”方向へ寄っています。Stratで気持ちよく前に出る、でもTS系の鼻づまり感までは行かない。その絶妙な立ち位置が、Blue Collarを単なる派生機ではなく定番にしています。 現行系統には、Blue Collar PTP、Blue Collar Mojo、Blue Collar Miniがあります。Blue Collar Miniは2025年版でPresenceを追加したと明記されており、コンパクトながら現代的な扱いやすさも増しています。Red Snapperが“抜ける透明OD”なら、Blue Collarは“厚みと歌心のあるOD”。MENATONE入門でどちらから入るかは、実はこの一文でかなり決まります。 小要約 Red Snapper は、開放感・透明感・タッチ重視。 Blue Collar は、太さ・歌い方・シングルコイル適性が強い。 MENATONEの歴史は、この2台を理解すると半分見えます。 British系の中核｜Workingman’s Blue、King of the Britains、The King Workingman’s Blue｜JTM45系の太い基礎教養 Workingman’s Blueは、FXDBの説明で 2001年初頭に登場 し、JTM45 “Bluesbreaker”回路全体をもとにしたモデルとされています。Rich deep bass、round clear top end、thickest, chewiest overdriveという表現からわかる通り、British系の中でも“古いMarshallの豊かさ”に重心があるモデルです。しかも途中からは フッ

Red Snapper 4kb PTP $229 Add to Cart The Red Snapper is the pedal that started it all for Menatone. It debuted in 1996 in its original 3 knob form made point to point, one at a time and is still made the same way 30 years later. The concept was simple, make the most transparent touch sensitive overdrive that could possibly be made, and three decades later it still holds up. The four knob version adds the hi cut control that is designed in such a way that it is completely out of the circuit when turned all the way down, but adds a level of tonal versatility that the three knob original cannot match. Red Snapper Mini $149 Add to Cart This is the mini version of the Red Snapper, because pedal board space is the most expensive real estate on earth. This tiny little guy is the same circuit as the original 3 knob Red Snapper with the addition of a couple of treble cut switches inside. About • Collections • Blog • Compare • Privacy Policy • Terms of Service • Submit a pedal • © 2026 PedalFilter Clear Compare ( 0 ) Back Home Menatone Red Snapper Mini Back to results Menatone Red Snapper Mini Overdrive Mini-enclosure Red Snapper overdrive with Gain, Tone and a hi-cut, using full-size parts. The Red Snapper Mini fits Menatone's four-knob Red Snapper overdrive into a compact mini enclosure while keeping full-size through-hole components inside. It carries the Red Snapper's touch-sensitive, transparent voice with Volume, Tone, a Gain control Menatone calls Bite, and a hi-cut to roll off top end. Because of the tight layout it runs on an external power supply only, with no room for a battery. It delivers the same amp-preserving overdrive as the full-size version in a footprint that saves pedalboard space, hand-built in the USA. sources.bodyExcerpt: Red Snapper Mini by Menatone | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Menatone Red Snapper Mini LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS OVERDRIVE BOOSTER Description This is the mini version of the Red Snapper, because pedal board space is the most expensive real estate on earth. This tiny little guy is the same circuit as the original 3 knob Red Snapper with the addition of a couple of treble cut switches inside. With the switches in the off position it is exactly the same circuit as the 3 knob Snapper. Full sized through hole parts are used throughout, no surface mount in here. The Red Snapper mini will be sold direct from Menatone only, which accounts for the amazing price. About • Collections • Blog • Compare • Privacy Policy • Terms of Service • Submit a pedal • © 2026 PedalFilter Clear Compare ( 0 ) Back Home Menatone The Dirty Blonde Back to results Menatone The Dirty Blonde Overdrive Tweed-voiced overdrive with cranked-American twang and Soul, Presence and Sag controls. The Dirty Blonde is a tweed-influenced overdrive built to capture cranked American amp tone and twang. Alongside Gain and Tone it adds three controls that shape the amp feel: Soul adds harmonic complexity and saturation, Presence sets the top-end bite, and Sag loosens the response for the soft, compressed attack of an overdriven tweed amp. That gives it a wide range from clean twang to a thick, spongy overdrive. The current version has all top-mounted jacks. Point-to-point hand-built in the USA, it's aimed at players chasing vintage American amp breakup. THE KING. This is the Menatone King. The King. is an entirely new design of the King of the Britains pedal deriving from all of my favorite British amp designs. From clean, to bluesy JTM45, in the lower gain settings, to roaring, snarling Plexi crunch in the mid gain, and liquid, searing brutality in the cranked settings, this new incarnation will truly prove its lineage amongst its rivals. This new for 2025 version is the same circuit as the original but with all internal controls on the outside and top mounted jacks for clean pedalboard layouts. ​ ​ Build time approx. 4-6 weeks Manual $219 Add to Cart Video Demos PRINT REVIEWS Here is another review from Paul at STOMP BOX STEALS http://stompboxsteals.blogspot.com/2016/08/menotone.html Exerpt - for full review click image above “Menatone’s The King.” is a well-rounded overdrive, distortion, boost pedal and one of the most versatile pedals chasing the “Marshall-in-a-box” sound. It’s overflowing with options for shaping your sound from EQ’d cleans to mild and heavier overdrive to all-out Marshall-inspired roar. I particularly recommend trying this pedal with single-coil pickups as it made me not want to put my Strat down. Fortunately, this pedal is tweak-able enough to pair with any guitar amp combo thanks to its extra voicing options under the hood, essential parameters for making the most of this pedal. Pair it with an overdrive for a match made in heaven. There isn’t much this pedal can’t do. For many guitarists it will prove itself appropriately named. Hail to The King. Exerpt - for full review click the link above "BUT HOW DOES IT SOUND? You can get a convincing Rolling Stone bottom heavy chunky distortion right up to a classic 70,s Metal and beyond that to a modern tight sounding Metal. This pedal has nailed the basic sounds that it was designed to do. I do not know of any (even the best) that have nailed the gutsy clean/dirty Stones sound What makes it easy to get accurate distinct voices is how the drive and gain knob work. If you set the drive low ...the gain reacts with less crunch ...but with the correct balance of the two. For example if you are trying for an early Plexi 100 watt amp. The drive is set low but the gain now reacts to the natural gain which that kind of amp being emulated has. So ...you then get a Hendrix 'The Wind Cries Mary' sound or a very 'Stones' like sound . The 3 way EQ then sets up your sound to perfection. It does not end there either...pull off the back and you have even more control! A trim pot to zero in a 60''s thru 70's voicing....and a modern /vintage switch. I think a lot of Marshall OD's are really giving you a Marshall plus Boss SD-1 sound because hundreds of classic recordings were made with that combination...nice ...but not accurate. I have these pedals and some are my essential tools. BUT...I would love to get a pedal with the correct voicing too. The King can do this. The most impressive thing is something one does not generally buy a Marshall pedal for. A dead accurate clean sound with the sound of the amp just before it breaks up. THE LAW BENDER $259 Add to Cart DEMOS Coming soon... The Law Bender Deluxe is the next evolution of the Menatone Law fuzz. Based on the same circuit but with the added 'PORK' control for more gain. The PORK control turns the first gain stage from a unity gain buffer, to a 12db exrtra boost stage similar to a MKii fuzz. The Law Bender goes from light overdrive to full blown nastiness. The new Deluxe version now has both silicone and germanium tranistors switchable in both stages. The Silicon has more gain on tap and a tigher response, while the Germanium has more midrange and an organic vibe with a bit less gain. Both provide a hugely dynamic experience with clarity and nuance not found in any other fuzz pedals. 1/2 Watt Carbon resistors and rolled poly caps are used throughout. Top Boost in a Can Wreck'T Fish Factory MenaWatt PiG The Dirty Blonde MINI Red Snapper Mini Red Snapper 4 knob Mini Blue Collar Mini JAC Compressor Mini Thundering Revival Mini The Law Mini Hindenburg Mini Mail Bomb Mini Pleasure Trem Mini Ms. Foxy Brown Mini PIPES IN STOCK CONTACT POLICIES DEALERS More Use tab to navigate through the menu items. The Law Mini Top of Page None More Black Deluxe The Law Mini Fuzz is a unique fuzz pedal inspired by classic FF-style fuzzes of the past. It utilizes two bipolar transistors and a buffer for its sonic mayhem. Unlike most fuzz circuits, the Law is usable in all control positions. With the Fuzz and Sag controls all the way down, a clean boost is possible with most single-coil pickups. In the mid positions, beautiful harmonically rich overdrives are present, and fully dimed, fire-breathing fuzz from the nether regions abide. The buffer not only makes the Law work great with other pedals such as Wahs, but it also makes guitar volume changes predictable. Please note that the Law Mini Fuzz requires a 9V power supply and cannot be powered by a battery. Build time is approximately 2-5 weeks . $159 Add to Cart DEMOS All demos played poorly by Menatone unless otherwise noted. Amp is a princeton style 5w running into a Ox Amp Top Box. Amp settings are very clean to not hide the sound of the pedal. strat bridge single coil - controls noon sag full - fuzz full - strat bridge single

sources.snippet: MENATONEの歴代歪み系ギターエフェクター完全解説｜Red SnapperからThe King、希少機まで
sources.bodyExcerpt: MENATONEの歴代歪み系ギターエフェクター完全解説｜Red SnapperからThe King、希少機まで｜エレキギター機材厨エンジニア 投稿 ログイン 会員登録 MENATONEの歴代歪み系ギターエフェクター完全解説｜Red SnapperからThe King、希少機まで 2 エレキギター機材厨エンジニア 2026年3月20日 20:36 結論から言うと、MENATONEの魅力は「ただのアンプシミュレーター」ではなく、アンプのフレーバーを歪みペダルとして実戦的に落とし込む設計にあります。 透明系の原点であるRed Snapper、より太く歌うBlue Collar、Marshall/Vox/Hiwatt/Trainwreck/Dumble系へ広がった多彩な系譜、そしてファズやハイゲイン機まで含めると、MENATONEの歴史は思った以上に奥深いです。 しかも現行公式サイトだけでは全体像が見えにくく、アーカイブや販売代理店情報を突き合わせないと“歴代”はつかみにくいブランドでもあります。 この記事では、確認できる一次情報とアーカイブ情報をもとに、MENATONEの歪み系をできるだけ体系的に整理します。 MENATONEとは何者か MENATONEは公式サイトで**“Effects Since 1996”**を掲げるハンドメイド・アナログ系ブランドです。現行公式サイトでは、PTP/Deluxe、Standard、Miniというカテゴリで多数の歪み系が並び、LEP Internationalの取扱ページでは27製品、Effects Databaseでは36製品が確認できます。つまり、ブランドの輪郭は公式で追えても、歴代の全体像はアーカイブと流通情報を重ねないと見えてきません。この記事ではその前提に立って、 歪み系＝オーバードライブ、ディストーション、アンプライクなドライブ、ファズ に絞って整理します。 もうひとつ大事なのは、MENATONEの“アンプ系”ペダルは、代理店の解説でも アンプそのものに完全変換するモデラーというより、元のアンプを活かしたままフレーバーを加える歪み として説明されていることです。これはShut Up Drive Miniの説明や、LEPのnote記事でも一貫していて、MENATONEを理解するキーワードは「再現」よりも「香りの抽出」に近いと考えるとわかりやすいです。だからこそ、同じMarshall系やVox系でも、他社の“○○そのもの”を強く名乗るペダルとは手触りが少し違います。 小要約 MENATONEは、 透明系ODの始祖クラス でもあり、 アンプの個性を“歪みペダルとして料理する”ブランド でもあります。 ここを押さえると、後の歴代モデルがつながって見えてきます。 まず全体像｜MENATONE歪み系の系譜 細かい発売順を厳密な年表で並べる前に、系統で見ると理解が一気に楽になります。大まかには、 Red Snapper系のオープンな低〜中ゲインOD群 、 Blue Collar系の太く歌うOD群 、 Marshall/Vox/Hiwatt/TrainwreckなどBritishアンプ派生群 、 DumbleやBlonde/Brownface、Supro系のAmerican/ブティック群 、そして ハイゲイン／ファズ群 に分けられます。公式・代理店・FXDBの説明を突き合わせると、MENATONEは単にモデル数が多いのではなく、歪みの設計思想ごとに枝分かれしてきたブランドだとわかります。 特に重要なのは、 Red Snapper→Blue Collar→Fish Factory という“基礎ODライン”、 Workingman’s Blue→King of the Britains→The King→Shut Up Drive/Thundering Revival/Redneck vs. Sputnik/None More Black というBritish拡張ライン、 Top Boost in a Can / MenaWatt / PiG / Kar Krash / Wreck’t という“英アンプ個性派ライン”、そして Howie / Dumbstruck / Dirty Blonde / Dirty B / Hindenburg / Ms.Foxy Brown というAmerican〜ブティック路線です。これを頭に入れておくと、歴代モデルを単発で覚える必要がなくなります。 原点の2台｜Red SnapperとBlue Collar Red Snapper｜MENATONEの始まり Red Snapperは、MENATONEにとって最重要モデルです。公式のMojo PTPページとLEPの解説では、もともと1996年に“Red”として始まり、1998年のNAMMで“Red Snapper”として広くデビューしたと説明されています。FXDBでも、3ノブ版から4ノブ版、各種レイアウト違いまで多くの写真が残っており、歴代歪み系の“起点”と見てまず間違いありません。 音のキャラクターは、公式・FXDBの両方が オープンで、コンプレッションが少なく、透明感のあるオーバードライブ として説明しています。2005年のFXDB説明では“transparent overdrive”、2009年の説明では“very open and uncompressed overdrive”とされ、Biteでピックアタック帯を押し出し、後段のHi Cutで高域を整える思想が読み取れます。つまりRed Snapperは、単なる“薄いOD”ではなく、 弾き手のピッキングとアンプの個性を殺さずに歪みを足す ためのペダルです。 世代差で大きいのは、 3ノブ版と4ノブ版 です。4ノブ版ではHi Cutが追加され、Biteで押し出した高域をあとから整えられるようになりました。しかも現行LEPページは、3ノブ版の冒頭スペック欄では「Vol / Gain / Cut」と書きつつ、本文では「Bite」の説明をしており、資料上に表記の食い違いがあります。中古で仕様確認をするときは、 商品名だけでなく実機写真のノブ名を必ず見る のが安全です。 現行派生としては、Red Snapper Mojo PTP、Red Snapper 4 Knob PTP、Red Snapper Mini、Red Snapper 4 Knob Miniが確認できます。Mini版も公式では「元回路と同じ」「フルサイズのスルーホール部品使用」と説明されており、単なる廉価縮小版というより、 省スペース化した本流 として扱うのが自然です。MENATONEを初めて買う人が“ブランドらしさ”を最短で知るなら、今もRed Snapper系は最有力候補です。 Blue Collar｜Red Snapperの“もっと太く、もっと歌う”側 Blue Collarは、公式説明では MENATONEの2番目のペダル設計 です。発売時期は公式内でも少し揺れがあり、Blue Collar PTP/miniでは1997年デビュー、Mojo版ではlate 1996とされていますが、少なくとも ブランド最初期の相棒 であることは確かです。Red Snapperに対して「もっとゲインとコンプレッションを」という要望から生まれた、という説明も一貫しています。 Blue Collarの要点は、 太いミッド、なめらかなコンプレッション、シングルコイルとの相性 です。公式は“fat, midrangey tone that loves single coils”、FXDBは“compressed, mid hump, singing bluesy overdrive”と書いており、Red Snapperの開放感に対して、Blue Collarはより“歌う”方向へ寄っています。Stratで気持ちよく前に出る、でもTS系の鼻づまり感までは行かない。その絶妙な立ち位置が、Blue Collarを単なる派生機ではなく定番にしています。 現行系統には、Blue Collar PTP、Blue Collar Mojo、Blue Collar Miniがあります。Blue Collar Miniは2025年版でPresenceを追加したと明記されており、コンパクトながら現代的な扱いやすさも増しています。Red Snapperが“抜ける透明OD”なら、Blue Collarは“厚みと歌心のあるOD”。MENATONE入門でどちらから入るかは、実はこの一文でかなり決まります。 小要約 Red Snapper は、開放感・透明感・タッチ重視。 Blue Collar は、太さ・歌い方・シングルコイル適性が強い。 MENATONEの歴史は、この2台を理解すると半分見えます。 British系の中核｜Workingman’s Blue、King of the Britains、The King Workingman’s Blue｜JTM45系の太い基礎教養 Workingman’s Blueは、FXDBの説明で 2001年初頭に登場 し、JTM45 “Bluesbreaker”回路全体をもとにしたモデルとされています。Rich deep bass、round clear top end、thickest, chewiest overdriveという表現からわかる通り、British系の中でも“古いMarshallの豊かさ”に重心があるモデルです。しかも途中からは フッ

Thundering Revival Mini Top of Page None More Black Deluxe The Thundering Revival is the natural companion to the Red Snapper and the Blue Collar. Producing a natural, thick and articulate distortion ranging from almost a clean boost to a cranked JCM800 levels. Its tone is not trying to turn your amp or guitar into something else, but works with them to create your style and sound. This mini version uses all through hole components and is internally voltage doubled for more headroom and fatness. Build time is approx. 2-4 weeks. $169 Add to Cart DEMOS All demos played poorly by Menatone unless otherwise noted. Amp is a princeton style 5w running into a Ox Amp Top Box. Amp settings are very clean to not hide the sound of the pedal. sources.bodyExcerpt: STOMP BOX STEALS: OVERDRIVE- MENATONE PEDALS Thundering Revival Mini ....Mr. Big Balz STOMP BOX STEALS Since 2015 NEW PEDALS EVERY DAY! Over 4400 REVIEWS! I use other reviewers vids then critique from them __ If a pedal appears killer I buy one __ I try it out update the Post__ If the pedal is SH@T I literally say so!__ I publish the street price a no brainer but few do. __ I save you time finding the best pedals you get a second opinion. __OVER 4 MILLION VISTORS__ NO ONE OWNS ME___ I MAKE ZERO $ FROM THIS Paul L. Ewing / LENARD Re-Inventions View my complete profile Tuesday, May 26, 2026 OVERDRIVE- MENATONE PEDALS Thundering Revival Mini ....Mr. Big Balz MENATONE's THUNDERING REVIVAL $170.00 USD Menatone have been making handmade pedals since 1996. The first biggie was the Red Snapper and since then instead of just new versions there have been spinoffs. The Snapper was very like a Tube Screamer yet a bit more transparent and it had bite that you could add that gave it poke and definition. This one is the last in the line of ever increasing versions that has a massive low end yet keeps the mids full but not overbearing. The layout is simple with Volume Tone and Gain. C ONCLUSION <> <> <> Damn impressive. The pedal has girth, poke and balz to spare. It also stacks well but only needs a clean sound to do its thing. I know of no comparison to get its sound other than to stack a Fuzz, an OD and an EQ. Add to that it does not eat up any real estate on your board. Posted by Paul L. Ewing / LENARD Re-Inventions at 6:40 PM Email This BlogThis! Ewing / LENARD Re-Inventions I have spent years in the music biz as a guitarist. I played in London England with the Prog rock band Tallis. I have always been curious in what makes an electric guitar, amp or pedal great. I was fortunate enough to make contacts with builders worldwide. I even had friends... old timers from the Gibson Kalamazoo factory. I learnt my craft from those that invented the electric guitars that we still love today. My design sensibility says "If it is not broke don't fix it!!!" I also feel the guitar is a tool! It is not a wall hanger display. Keep it simple! Keep to what works! As for pedals. I have many friends that are popular YouTubers as well as Independent pedal builders that give me a heads up about new things even before the release date. This way you can find it here first. About • Collections • Blog • Compare • Privacy Policy • Terms of Service • Submit a pedal • © 2026 PedalFilter Clear Compare ( 0 ) Back Home Menatone Wreck'T Back to results Menatone Wreck'T Overdrive Distortion Amp-in-a-box drive after a Fischer/Trainwreck-style amp, from AC30 chime to Plexi roar. The Wreck'T is an amp-in-a-box overdrive and distortion voiced after the hand-built amplifiers of Ken Fischer, mixing British amp character with an American gain structure. A full amp-style control set of Drive, Tone, Level, Presence and Cut lets it move from AC30-style chime at lower gain up to a Plexi-style roar when pushed, with the Presence and Cut controls shaping the top end like a real amp's. Rather than a simple boost it's meant to be a preamp-like main drive. The current version has updated top-mounted jacks, hand-built in the USA. The Wreck'T 2.0 is the revised version of Menatone's Wreck'T, an amp-in-a-box overdrive and distortion inspired by hand-built amplifier tones. sources.title: Mesa/Boogie Cleo – Gibson
sources.description: You already know MESA® Pedals are built by the very same artisans that create the Award Winning Mark Five™, the legendary Dual and Triple Rectifier® and the soulful new vintage-voiced offerings, Fillmore and California Tweed. Now here are three exciting new hand-built overdrive pedals spanning the entire range of gain and stylistic spectrum. Cleo™ commands the lower end of the gain scale anchoring Blues, Roots, Indie Rock and even doubles as a hearty Boost, while it enhances, not covers up, the sound of your instrument. With sweet, open top end clarity and not too much saturation, it allows you to craft anything from a subtle boost up through urgent mid gain drive to harmonically-rich overdrive, all in the spirit of Tradition. Progressing along the gain spectrum, the transparent boost/overdrive CLEO™ is joined by the vintage-inspired, medium-gain DYNAPLEX™ and the higher-gain GOLD MINE™. Find your sound among these three new catalysts, combine them to create a new Tone all your own or keep them all on deck to cover the entire Ball Park of sounds you may need regardless of the Gig. Whichever path you take to enhancing your Tone, rest assured you’ve invested in quality and service unparalleled with a Brand that’s been around for a half century and will be there for you should you ever need assistance. Like each and every MESA product, these pedals are built using the same quality components and craftsmanship and are filled with the inspiring performance found in our custom amplifiers, all of which are hand-built in our only Shop in Petaluma California, USA—the Home of Tone®!

sources.title: Mesa/Boogie DynaPlex – Gibson
sources.description: You already know MESA® Pedals are built by the very same artisans that create the Award-Winning Mark Five™, the legendary Dual and Triple Rectifier® and the soulful new vintage-voiced offerings, Fillmore and California Tweed. Now here are three exciting new hand-built overdrive pedals spanning the entire range of gain and stylistic spectrum. DynaPlex™ goes straight to the heart of mid gain Brit, beyond Classic Crunch and ‘70s Rock sounds with a tactile feel and truly versatile, broad gain range. Whether feeding on Single Coils or Humbuckers, the personality shines through in the most classic of ways with a ripping harmonic edge and cracking attack filled with attitude. A treasure trove of crunch rhythm awaits at the lower end of the Gain control, fatness and liquidity creep in just where you’d expect when gain is cranked for single note work, both keeping dynamic excitement front and center. Progressing along the gain spectrum, the transparent boost/overdrive CLEO™ is joined by the vintage-inspired, medium=gain DYNAPLEX™ and the higher-gain GOLD MINE™. Find your sound among these three new catalysts, combine them to create a new Tone all your own or keep them all on deck to cover the entire Ball Park of sounds you may need regardless of the Gig. Whichever path you take to enhancing your Tone, rest assured you’ve invested in quality and service unparalleled with a Brand that’s been around for a half century and will be there for you should you ever need assistance. DynaPlex™ features a hidden EQ switch on the circuit board accessible from the bottom under the removable Lid that offers a more scooped, mid-dipped EQ curve. When engaged, this switch softens the Brit, mid-forward character of The Dynaplex for a leaner sound. Like each and every MESA product, these pedals are built using the same quality components and craftsmanship and are filled with the inspiring performance found in our custom amplifiers, all of which are hand-built in our only Shop in Petaluma California, USA—the Home of Tone®!

sources.title: Mesa/Boogie Throttle Box – Gibson
sources.description: The THROTTLE BOX™ Distortion serves up all genres of ROCK with cut and aggression, but retains the signature warmth and organic sonic quality found in all our amplifiers. While its main strengths lie in higher-gain sounds, it is quite versatile and it’s lower gain options shouldn’t be overlooked for classic rock or howling blues. The THROTTLE BOX also features a unique MID CUT that scoops out midrange to produce the signature Boogie® “V” EQ-curve that so many artists have employed in our amps to create the world’s heaviest guitar tones! sources.title: Mesa/Boogie Tone-Burst – Gibson
sources.description: The TONE-BURST™ Boost/Overdrive offers a virtually transparent gain range usually associated with “clean” boost pedals. However, the TONE-BURST has enough gain to boost your guitar to the threshold of clip and slightly beyond, making it far more useful for a variety of applications. It’s incredibly powerful for adding boost, drive and/or EQ to any guitar and amp combination. Whether using it as a utility to boost the output of single coils to match a humbucker or as a subtle overdrive when a standard overdrive may be too much, the TONE-BURST is an incredibly useful and expressive pedal that makes the best things sound even better! Features

sources.bodyExcerpt: Guitar Pedal X - GPX Blog - 9 of the Best MI Audio / MI Effects Pedals ao link News GPX AI Forums Notifications Popular Highlights 4 of a Kind 12 Degrees of Saturation ArtistArray Best in Class Best of Brands Builder Profiles Colours Expo Guitar Pedal 101 Iconic Gear In Memoriam Pedal Chain Pedal Planet Trifecta Versus Index News GPX AI Forums Notifications Popular Highlights 4 of a Kind 12 Degrees of Saturation ArtistArray Best in Class Best of Brands Builder Profiles Colours Expo Guitar Pedal 101 Iconic Gear In Memoriam Pedal Chain Pedal Planet Trifecta Versus Index Enter a search term Search Remember Login Register | Reset Password Xploration • Curation • Recommendation News GPX AI Forums Notifications Popular Highlights 4 of a Kind 12 Degrees of Saturation ArtistArray Best in Class Best of Brands Builder Profiles Colours Expo Guitar Pedal 101 Iconic Gear In Memoriam Pedal Chain Pedal Planet Trifecta Versus Index News GPX AI Forums Notifications Popular Highlights 4 of a Kind 12 Degrees of Saturation ArtistArray Best in Class Best of Brands Builder Profiles Colours Expo Guitar Pedal 101 Iconic Gear In Memoriam Pedal Chain Pedal Planet Trifecta Versus Index Enter a search term Search Remember Login Register | Reset Password Filter content by area of interest Amps Boost and Overdrive Delay Distortion Fuzz Guitars Modulation Pitch Reverb Utility All All 9 of the Best MI Audio / MI Effects Pedals Oct 28, 2018 00:58 by Stefan Karlsson Best of Brands Boost Boost and Overdrive Brown Sound Distortion Delay Digital Delay Distortion Effects Pedal Makers Fuzz Germanium Fuzz Klone and Transparent Overdrive Lo-Fi Delay Metal Distortion MI Audio MI Effects Michael Ibrahim Octave Fuzz Overdrive Silicon Fuzz Tubescreamer Style Overdrive + - Full Article Read Summary Key Points MI Effects makes compact V1 and larger V2 overdrive, fuzz, delay and high‑gain pedals with multi‑control “tweaker” topologies. Distribution is limited in the UK; buys have been via Reverb, Haar Guitars (Netherlands) and Musik Produktiv (Germany). Blue Boy Deluxe Overdrive V1 — Tube‑Screamer style, Bright/Mids/Tone/Character. As of 2026-07-13, the price was £100. Cross Over Drive V2 — 4 FET stages, 2‑band EQ. As of 2026-07-13, the price was £120. GI Fuzz V1 — Bias/Load/Bright toggle. As of 2026-07-13, the price was £120. Lo‑Fi Delay — PT2399, 600ms. As of 2026-07-13, the price was £120. Megalith Delta V2 — high gain, Contour/EQ Shift. As of 2026-07-13, the price was £230. Neo Fuzz V1 — AC128 germanium. As of 2026-07-13, the price was £120. Pollyanna Octave Synth Fuzz V1 — two down/one up octaves. As of 2026-07-13, the price was £120. Super Blues Pro — TS‑style core, silicon/MOSFET clipping. As of 2026-07-13, the price was £120. Super Crunch Box V2 — brown‑sound, 3‑band EQ+Presence. As of 2026-07-13, the price was £121. Megalith Delta and Super Crunch Box are described as permanent pedal‑chain fixtures; Lo‑Fi Delay, Pollyanna and Super Blues Pro remain to be acquired. Readers of this blog will know that I’m quite the fan of Michael Ibrahim’s MI Effects Pedals. I’ve had two as a permanent fixture in my pedal-chain for quite a considerable time already - the Super Crunch Box V2 and the super high gain Megalith Delta - which are both exceptional performers in their respective categories. I’ve long had a number of his other pedals in my sight too - in particular his two earlier V1 compact fuzzes - the G.I. and Neo - or Silicon and Germanium versions. sources.title: Mid-Fi Electronics ::: Another/An-other (Fuzz Version)
sources.description: The Another/An-other is a frequency dependent fuzz/chopper.First your signal is fuzzed up and split in two. Half goes to an electronic switch then the output. The other half goes to a frequency divider which divides whatever you play in half (up to 12 times via the “Frequency” rotary switch). That signal then tells the electronic switch when to turn on/off.The result? A choppy/fuzzy trem/ring mod/divider who’s frequency changes based on what note(s) you’re playing!!! CONTROLSVolumeRotary switch for frequency division rangeFEATURESTrue Bypass9V DC (negative tip)

The other half goes to a frequency divider which divides whatever you play in half (up to 12 times via the “Frequency” rotary switch).
